knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Eye protection named on a product label belongs in the protective equipment class. A bucket (option 0) is a piece of equipment or a consumable, and a work order (option 2) is a document.

Incompatible products are separated and secured in different positions, as the lesson requires for storage. Keeping them together (option 0) and mixing them (option 2) are the errors the lesson warns against.
The lesson says products are the cleaning and maintenance chemicals, which carry labels and SDS.

practicalCriteria: Learner lists every item in a supplied job kit and assigns each to one of the six classes.
Learner records the storage place and check for each class and separates products by incompatibility.
Learner confirms that each product in the kit is labelled and has its SDS in the documents class.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Kit list with class, storage place and check for each item
Kit change record when items are added or removed
stopWorkCriteria: Learner carries a product without its SDS
